description: Project-level Claude Code settings for edopro-retro-formats. One hook: capture each session's final reply into a shared .git/agent-inbox/ so Brain and Worker (when both run as Claude Code, in the worktrees described in docs/agents/worktree-mechanism.md) don't rely on the human copy-pasting reports. It only fires for Claude Code sessions -- a Worker round run through a different vendor's tool never writes there, so a missing or stale inbox file means 'unknown', never 'nothing happened'. The push-readiness gate deliberately does NOT live here: it is a real Git pre-push hook (.githooks/pre-push -> scripts/check_push_readiness.py, tested by tests/test_push_readiness.py), because a Claude Code Bash hook both missed ordinary pushes and blocked non-pushes, and never fired at all for a non-Claude Worker. See docs/agents/push-gate.md. Hook interpreter is `python`, matching this project's own documented Windows fallback (README: 'On Windows, use python or py -3 if python3 is not available') and confirmed working on the primary dev machine, which has no python3 on PATH at all. A macOS/Linux setup where only python3 exists needs the `command` string below changed to python3 -- there is no single invocation proven portable across this project's actual two OSes, so don't silently assume one direction is universally safer than the other.
